svg.title: A new start whose first beacons are lost
svg.desc: The vehicle started only a moment ago, so its beacon numbers are low. It takes a RESTART and beacon 3 carries the flag, ending the match. The new start's beacons 1 to 3 are all lost, so beacon 4 looks like the next of the old start and the link stays up; but its flag is set, so the station is still not matched and would refuse a START_NODE unsent. The operator presses Disconnect and Connect; the CONNECT matches, the vehicle clears the flag, and beacon 5, normal, makes the station matched for commanding. Nothing is stuck.

text.style: font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold
